plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE beyond shared time trend
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is 2 conditions x 4 time points x 3 replicates (24 samples, 12000 genes, salmon raw counts). The research question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend shown by both conditions — is precisely the DESeq2 time-course interaction question: fit ~condition + time + condition:time and test the interaction term with a likelihood ratio test against the reduced model ~condition + time. Genes with a significant interaction have a time trajectory that differs between the two conditions; genes with a significant time term but no interaction share the trend across conditions and are excluded from the answer. With 3 replicates per condition:time cell, the interaction test (a difference of differences) has low power, so this is stated explicitly and simple effects are reported alongside as required by the Inflexa procedure. Sample QC precedes the model to rule out a batch or outlier artifact; the DE step follows the flagged/grounded procedure (DESeq2 LRT, apeglm shrinkage of the per-timepoint condition effect, BH-FDR with independent filtering); the significant interaction genes are clustered by time-course trajectory and analyzed for pathway over-representation against the tested-gene universe (Hallmark, Reactome, WikiPathways, all present for human in the reference store — GSEA-preranked was checked against the knowledge service and rejected for this situation in favor of ORA with an explicit universe); the report closes with the required power caveat, simple-effects table, and reproducibility record.
